phrase: an A2 and Organic Milk Business
verdict: Yes, for a founder ready to run a farm. Humpy A2 from Pune pitched organic A2 milk and dairy products on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Urban buyers pay a premium for milk from Indian cow breeds, but the premium only holds if you prove purity and deliver reliably.
angle: A2 milk comes from indigenous breeds such as Gir and Sahiwal. Buyers pay more, though health claims about A2 are still debated, so keep claims modest. Ghee from A2 milk sells at very high prices and ships well.
